Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.\n#\n# Exercises ./ledger against a fresh database and compares every command's exit code and standard\n# output with the known answer below. Standard error is never compared.\n#\n#   sh sources/run.sh                    from the application root (how `drydock uat` runs it)\n#   sh uat/LayersTesting/bin/run.sh APP  from anywhere, grading the application root APP\n#\n# Database: DATABASE_URL when the caller sets it (for example a PostgreSQL DSN), otherwise a\n# SQLite file in a fresh temporary directory. Every run starts with `ledger init`, so the grader\n# never depends on prior state. Exit 0 only when every check passes.\nset -u\n\nHERE=$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\nAPP=$(cd \"${1:-.}\" && pwd)\nif [ -f \"$HERE/seed_accounts.csv\" ]; then SEED=$HERE; else SEED=$(cd \"$HERE/../sources\" && pwd); fi\nLEDGER=\"$APP/ledger\"\nWORK=$(mktemp -d)\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$WORK\"' EXIT INT TERM\nDATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-$WORK/ledger.db}\nexport DATABASE_URL\n\nif [ ! -x \"$LEDGER\" ]; then\n    echo \"error: no executable ./ledger at the application root $APP.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is an executable named ledger at the application root.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nPASSED=0\nFAILED=0\n\n# check <id> <expected exit> <ledger args...>  — expected standard output on stdin.\ncheck() {\n    id=$1\n    want_rc=$2\n    shift 2\n    cat > \"$WORK/want\"\n    (cd \"$APP\" && \"$LEDGER\" \"$@\") > \"$WORK/got\" 2> \"$WORK/err\"\n    rc=$?\n    if [ \"$rc\" -eq \"$want_rc\" ] && cmp -s \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\"; then\n        PASSED=$((PASSED + 1))\n        echo \"PASS $id: ledger $*\"\n    else\n        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))\n        echo \"FAIL $id: ledger $*\"\n        echo \"  exit: expected $want_rc, got $rc\"\n        diff \"$WORK/want\" \"$WORK/got\" | sed 's/^/  /'\n        sed 's/^/  stderr: /' \"$WORK/err\"\n    fi\n}\n\n# ── A. Schema lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ncheck A1 0 init < /dev/null\ncheck A2 0 count <<'EOF'\ntable,rows\naccounts,0\ncategories,0\ntransactions,0\nEOF\n\n# ── B. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UdJ1WdJ9PT5zXNiWXFKeKt","type":"tool_result","content":"=== cli/__init__.py\n\"\"\"The ledger command line: parse, dispatch, and map the outcome to an exit code.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\n\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\nfrom cli import commands  # noqa: F401  (importing registers every command module)\nfrom cli.database import open_ledger\nfrom cli.errors import LedgerError\nfrom cli.output import write_rows\nfrom cli.registry import resolve\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Run one ledger command and return its exit code. Standard output carries only the rows.\n\n    The handler runs to completion before anything is written, so a failing command writes nothing\n    to standard output. Diagnostics go to standard error as one line.\n    \"\"\"\n    words = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)\n    try:\n        command, args = resolve(words)\n        with open_ledger() as db:\n            rows = command.handler(db, args)\n    except LedgerError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n    except PersistenceError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 1\n    write_rows(rows)\n    return 0\n=== cli/__main__.py\n\"\"\"Lets ``python -m cli`` run the ledger, the same entry point the ``ledger`` launcher uses.\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\n\nfrom cli import main\n\nsys.exit(main())\n=== cli/balance.py\n\"\"\"Account balances and the non-negative balance rule every mutating command applies before it writes.\n\nBalances are computed from stored transaction rows in integer cents. Nothing here writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\n\n\ndef account_summary(db, code: str) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"The stored transaction count and balance in cents of ``code``; ``(0, 0)`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return len(rows), sum(row.amount for row in rows)\n\n\ndef balances(db) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Balance in cents for every account that has at least one stored transaction.\"\"\"\n    totals: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for row in db.transactions.list():\n        totals[row.account] = totals.get(row.account, 0) + row.amount\n    return totals\n\n\ndef check_balances(db, deltas: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject (exit 3) when any account's stored balance plus its proposed change is below zero.\n\n    ``deltas`` maps an account code to the net change in cents the command would make. A balance of\n    exactly zero is allowed. Raises ``Rejected`` before anything is written; returns ``None`` otherwise.\n    \"\"\"\n    current = balances(db)\n    for account in sorted(deltas):\n        after = current.get(account, 0) + deltas[account]\n        if after < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"balance of {account} would be {format_amount(after)}, below zero\")\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db) -> int:\n    \"\"\"One more than the largest stored ``txn_id``, or ``1`` when no transaction is stored.\"\"\"\n    return max((row.txn_id for row in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n=== cli/commands/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Command modules. Each module registers its handlers when imported; every module is loaded here.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\n\nfor _module in pkgutil.iter_modules(__path__):\n    importlib.import_module(f\"{__name__}.{_module.name}\")\n=== cli/commands/count.py\n\"\"\"``ledger count``: the number of stored rows in each table, read from the database.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Header ``table,rows``, then accounts, categories, and transactions in that order.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nregister((\"count\",), 0, 0, count)\n=== cli/commands/init.py\n\"\"\"``ledger init``: reset the ledger to empty. Writes nothing to standard output.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Delete transactions first, then categories and accounts, so no foreign key is violated.\"\"\"\n    for row in db.transactions.list():\n        db.transactions.delete(txn_id=row.txn_id)\n    for row in db.categories.list():\n        db.categories.delete(category=row.category)\n    for row in db.accounts.list():\n        db.accounts.delete(account=row.account)\n    return []\n\n\nregister((\"init\",), 0, 0, init)\n=== cli/commands/load_accounts.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load accounts <csv>``: all-or-nothing load of an accounts file.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.loader import read_csv_rows\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_code, validate_name\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row and rule first; write only once the whole file has passed.\"\"\"\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for code_text, name_text in read_csv_rows(args[0], (\"account\", \"name\")):\n        code = validate_code(code_text)\n        name = validate_name(name_text)\n        if code in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} appears more than once in the file\")\n        if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n        seen.add(code)\n        checked.append((code, name))\n    for code, name in checked:\n        db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"accounts\"), 1, 1, load_accounts)\n=== cli/commands/load_categories.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load categories <csv>``: all-or-nothing load of a categories file.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.loader import read_csv_rows\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_code, validate_description\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row and rule first; write only once the whole file has passed.\"\"\"\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for code_text, description_text in read_csv_rows(args[0], (\"category\", \"description\")):\n        code = validate_code(code_text)\n        description = validate_description(description_text)\n        if code in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"category {code} appears more than once in the file\")\n        if db.categories.get(category=code) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"category {code} already exists\")\n        seen.add(code)\n        checked.append((code, description))\n    for code, description in checked:\n        db.categories.create(category=code, description=description)\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"categories\"), 1, 1, load_categories)\n=== cli/database.py\n\"\"\"Open the ledger's store. The only place the database location is resolved.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\n\n\ndef database_location() -> str:\n    \"\"\"``DATABASE_URL``, then ``DATABASE_PATH``, then ``data/app.db``. Empty values count as unset.\"\"\"\n    return (\n        os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n        or os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\")\n        or DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n    )\n\n\ndef open_ledger() -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the configured store through the shipped persistence library.\"\"\"\n    return open_database(database_location())\n=== cli/errors.py\n\"\"\"Expected failures of the ledger, each carrying the exit code the process reports.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An expected failure. ``exit_code`` is what the dispatcher returns for it.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int = 1\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A failure of the ledger's own operation, such as an unreadable input file.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n\n\nclass Usage(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A command line the ledger does not accept: unknown command, table, or report, or arity.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 2\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Input that fails validation or a business rule. Nothing has been written.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A well-formed request for a record that does not exist.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n=== cli/loader.py\n\"\"\"Read a bulk-load CSV file into rows of text. Field rules are applied by each load command.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom cli.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\n\ndef read_csv_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the data rows of ``path``, each checked to carry exactly ``len(header)`` fields.\n\n    An unreadable file raises ``Operational`` (exit 1). A header other than ``header`` or a row with\n    the wrong number of fields raises ``Rejected`` (exit 3). Nothing is written here.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            records = list(csv.reader(fh))\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, csv.Error) as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc}\") from exc\n    if not records or records[0] != list(header):\n        raise Rejected(f\"header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n    rows = []\n    for number, record in enumerate(records[1:], start=2):\n        if len(record) != len(header):\n            raise Rejected(f\"line {number} must have {len(header)} fields\")\n        rows.append(record)\n    return rows\n=== cli/money.py\n\"\"\"Money as integer cents. Text is parsed and formatted with integer arithmetic only.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\n\nAMOUNT_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and any other shape are rejected.\"\"\"\n    match = AMOUNT_PATTERN.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like 12.50 or -3.1, with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_amount(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Format integer cents as a two-decimal amount with a leading ``-`` when negative.\"\"\"\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(cents), 100)\n    return f\"{sign}{whole}.{fraction:02d}\"\n=== cli/output.py\n\"\"\"Standard-output CSV: comma-separated, ``\\\\n`` line endings, no quoting.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\n\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef write_rows(rows: Sequence[Sequence[str]]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write each row as one CSV line to standard output. Callers pass validated fields only.\"\"\"\n    out = sys.stdout\n    for row in rows:\n        out.write(\",\".join(row) + \"\\n\")\n\n\ndef format_transaction(row: Any) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The six declared CSV fields of a transaction row, with the amount as two decimals.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        str(row.txn_id),\n        row.date,\n        row.account,\n        row.category,\n        format_amount(row.amount),\n        row.memo,\n    ]\n=== cli/registry.py\n\"\"\"The command table. Each command module registers its handlers here at import time.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom cli.errors import Usage\n\nHandler = Callable[[object, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Command:\n    \"\"\"One registered command: the words that name it, its argument bounds, and its handler.\"\"\"\n\n    path: tuple[str, ...]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int\n    handler: Handler\n\n\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef register(path: Sequence[str], min_args: int, max_args: int, handler: Handler) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Register ``handler`` for the command words ``path``.\n\n    ``handler(db, args)`` returns the header row followed by the data rows. Registering the same\n    path twice is a programming error and raises ``ValueError``.\n    \"\"\"\n    key = tuple(path)\n    if not key:\n        raise ValueError(\"a command path needs at least one word\")\n    if key in COMMANDS:\n        raise ValueError(f\"command {' '.join(key)!r} is already registered\")\n    COMMANDS[key] = Command(key, min_args, max_args, handler)\n\n\ndef resolve(argv: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[Command, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Find the command named by the leading words of ``argv`` and check its argument count.\n\n    Raises ``Usage`` for no command, an unknown command, or a wrong argument count. Nothing is\n    opened or written here.\n    \"\"\"\n    matches = [command for key, command in COMMANDS.items() if tuple(argv[: len(key)]) == key]\n    if not matches:\n        raise Usage(\"unknown command: \" + (\" \".join(argv) if argv else \"(none)\"))\n    command = max(matches, key=lambda item: len(item.path))\n    args = list(argv[len(command.path) :])\n    if not command.min_args <= len(args) <= command.max_args:\n        raise Usage(f\"{' '.join(command.path)} takes {command.min_args} to {command.max_args} arguments\")\n    return command, args\n=== cli/testing.py\n\"\"\"In-process runner for criteria and tests: returns (exit_code, stdout, stderr) without a process.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Run the ledger with ``args`` and return what it returned and wrote.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()\n=== cli/validate.py\n\"\"\"Input validators shared by every command. Each returns its value or raises ``Rejected``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom datetime import date\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,12}\")\nDATE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\")\n# Commas would split a CSV field and line breaks would split a row, so neither may appear in text.\nFORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An account or category code: 1 to 12 characters from ``A-Z`` and ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    if not CODE_PATTERN.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(f\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9: {text!r}\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef validate_name(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A name: 1 to 40 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"name\", text, 1, 40)\n\n\ndef validate_description(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A category description: 1 to 40 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"description\", text, 1, 40)\n\n\ndef validate_memo(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A memo: 0 to 60 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"memo\", text, 0, 60)\n\n\ndef validate_date(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    if DATE_PATTERN.fullmatch(text):\n        try:\n            date.fromisoformat(text)\n            return text\n        except ValueError:\n            pass\n    raise Rejected(f\"date must be a real calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD: {text!r}\")\n\n\ndef _validate_text(label: str, text: str, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> str:\n    if not minimum <= len(text) <= maximum:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {minimum} to {maximum} characters\")\n    if any(mark in text for mark in FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or line break\")\n    return Each module registers its handlers when imported; every module is loaded here.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\n\nfor _module in pkgutil.iter_modules(__path__):\n    importlib.import_module(f\"{__name__}.{_module.name}\")\n=== cli/commands/count.py\n\"\"\"``ledger count``: the number of stored rows in each table, read from the database.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Header ``table,rows``, then accounts, categories, and transactions in that order.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nregister((\"count\",), 0, 0, count)\n=== cli/commands/init.py\n\"\"\"``ledger init``: reset the ledger to empty. Writes nothing to standard output.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Delete transactions first, then categories and accounts, so no foreign key is violated.\"\"\"\n    for row in db.transactions.list():\n        db.transactions.delete(txn_id=row.txn_id)\n    for row in db.categories.list():\n        db.categories.delete(category=row.category)\n    for row in db.accounts.list():\n        db.accounts.delete(account=row.account)\n    return []\n\n\nregister((\"init\",), 0, 0, init)\n=== cli/commands/load_accounts.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load accounts <csv>``: all-or-nothing load of an accounts file.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.loader import read_csv_rows\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_code, validate_name\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row and rule first; write only once the whole file has passed.\"\"\"\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for code_text, name_text in read_csv_rows(args[0], (\"account\", \"name\")):\n        code = validate_code(code_text)\n        name = validate_name(name_text)\n        if code in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} appears more than once in the file\")\n        if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n        seen.add(code)\n        checked.append((code, name))\n    for code, name in checked:\n        db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"accounts\"), 1, 1, load_accounts)\n=== cli/commands/load_categories.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load categories <csv>``: all-or-nothing load of a categories file.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.loader import read_csv_rows\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_code, validate_description\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row and rule first; write only once the whole file has passed.\"\"\"\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for code_text, description_text in read_csv_rows(args[0], (\"category\", \"description\")):\n        code = validate_code(code_text)\n        description = validate_description(description_text)\n        if code in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"category {code} appears more than once in the file\")\n        if db.categories.get(category=code) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"category {code} already exists\")\n        seen.add(code)\n        checked.append((code, description))\n    for code, description in checked:\n        db.categories.create(category=code, description=description)\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"categories\"), 1, 1, load_categories)\n=== cli/database.py\n\"\"\"Open the ledger's store. The only place the database location is resolved.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\n\n\ndef database_location() -> str:\n    \"\"\"``DATABASE_URL``, then ``DATABASE_PATH``, then ``data/app.db``. Empty values count as unset.\"\"\"\n    return (\n        os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n        or os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\")\n        or DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n    )\n\n\ndef open_ledger() -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the configured store through the shipped persistence library.\"\"\"\n    return open_database(database_location())\n=== cli/errors.py\n\"\"\"Expected failures of the ledger, each carrying the exit code the process reports.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An expected failure. ``exit_code`` is what the dispatcher returns for it.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int = 1\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A failure of the ledger's own operation, such as an unreadable input file.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n\n\nclass Usage(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A command line the ledger does not accept: unknown command, table, or report, or arity.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 2\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Input that fails validation or a business rule. Nothing has been written.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"A well-formed request for a record that does not exist.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n=== cli/loader.py\n\"\"\"Read a bulk-load CSV file into rows of text. Field rules are applied by each load command.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom cli.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\n\ndef read_csv_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the data rows of ``path``, each checked to carry exactly ``len(header)`` fields.\n\n    An unreadable file raises ``Operational`` (exit 1). A header other than ``header`` or a row with\n    the wrong number of fields raises ``Rejected`` (exit 3). Nothing is written here.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            records = list(csv.reader(fh))\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, csv.Error) as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc}\") from exc\n    if not records or records[0] != list(header):\n        raise Rejected(f\"header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n    rows = []\n    for number, record in enumerate(records[1:], start=2):\n        if len(record) != len(header):\n            raise Rejected(f\"line {number} must have {len(header)} fields\")\n        rows.append(record)\n    return rows\n=== cli/money.py\n\"\"\"Money as integer cents. Text is parsed and formatted with integer arithmetic only.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\n\nAMOUNT_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and any other shape are rejected.\"\"\"\n    match = AMOUNT_PATTERN.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like 12.50 or -3.1, with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_amount(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Format integer cents as a two-decimal amount with a leading ``-`` when negative.\"\"\"\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(cents), 100)\n    return f\"{sign}{whole}.{fraction:02d}\"\n=== cli/output.py\n\"\"\"Standard-output CSV: comma-separated, ``\\\\n`` line endings, no quoting.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\n\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef write_rows(rows: Sequence[Sequence[str]]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write each row as one CSV line to standard output. Callers pass validated fields only.\"\"\"\n    out = sys.stdout\n    for row in rows:\n        out.write(\",\".join(row) + \"\\n\")\n\n\ndef format_transaction(row: Any) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The six declared CSV fields of a transaction row, with the amount as two decimals.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        str(row.txn_id),\n        row.date,\n        row.account,\n        row.category,\n        format_amount(row.amount),\n        row.memo,\n    ]\n=== cli/registry.py\n\"\"\"The command table. Each command module registers its handlers here at import time.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom cli.errors import Usage\n\nHandler = Callable[[object, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Command:\n    \"\"\"One registered command: the words that name it, its argument bounds, and its handler.\"\"\"\n\n    path: tuple[str, ...]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int\n    handler: Handler\n\n\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef register(path: Sequence[str], min_args: int, max_args: int, handler: Handler) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Register ``handler`` for the command words ``path``.\n\n    ``handler(db, args)`` returns the header row followed by the data rows. Registering the same\n    path twice is a programming error and raises ``ValueError``.\n    \"\"\"\n    key = tuple(path)\n    if not key:\n        raise ValueError(\"a command path needs at least one word\")\n    if key in COMMANDS:\n        raise ValueError(f\"command {' '.join(key)!r} is already registered\")\n    COMMANDS[key] = Command(key, min_args, max_args, handler)\n\n\ndef resolve(argv: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[Command, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Find the command named by the leading words of ``argv`` and check its argument count.\n\n    Raises ``Usage`` for no command, an unknown command, or a wrong argument count. Nothing is\n    opened or written here.\n    \"\"\"\n    matches = [command for key, command in COMMANDS.items() if tuple(argv[: len(key)]) == key]\n    if not matches:\n        raise Usage(\"unknown command: \" + (\" \".join(argv) if argv else \"(none)\"))\n    command = max(matches, key=lambda item: len(item.path))\n    args = list(argv[len(command.path) :])\n    if not command.min_args <= len(args) <= command.max_args:\n        raise Usage(f\"{' '.join(command.path)} takes {command.min_args} to {command.max_args} arguments\")\n    return command, args\n=== cli/testing.py\n\"\"\"In-process runner for criteria and tests: returns (exit_code, stdout, stderr) without a process.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Run the ledger with ``args`` and return what it returned and wrote.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()\n=== cli/validate.py\n\"\"\"Input validators shared by every command. Each returns its value or raises ``Rejected``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom datetime import date\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,12}\")\nDATE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\")\n# Commas would split a CSV field and line breaks would split a row, so neither may appear in text.\nFORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An account or category code: 1 to 12 characters from ``A-Z`` and ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    if not CODE_PATTERN.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(f\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9: {text!r}\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef validate_name(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A name: 1 to 40 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"name\", text, 1, 40)\n\n\ndef validate_description(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A category description: 1 to 40 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"description\", text, 1, 40)\n\n\ndef validate_memo(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A memo: 0 to 60 characters, with no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    return _validate_text(\"memo\", text, 0, 60)\n\n\ndef validate_date(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    if DATE_PATTERN.fullmatch(text):\n        try:\n            date.fromisoformat(text)\n            return text\n        except ValueError:\n            pass\n    raise Rejected(f\"date must be a real calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD: {text!r}\")\n\n\ndef _validate_text(label: str, text: str, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> str:\n    if not minimum <= len(text) <= maximum:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {minimum} to {maximum} characters\")\n    if any(mark in text for mark in FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or line break\")\n    return Connection\n    handling is internal and may change without affecting any caller.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, dsn: str, schema: Schema, *, driver: Driver | None = None) -> None:\n        self._rollback_owner = None\n        self._schema = schema\n        driver = driver if driver is not None else open_driver(dsn)\n        self._harness = _harness\n        self._driver = self._harness.join(driver) if self._harness is not None else driver\n        grouped = schema.by_table()\n        for table in schema.tables:\n            setattr(self, table.name, TableAccess(table, grouped.get(table.name, ()), self))\n\n    @property\n    def driver(self) -> Driver:\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"driver access is forbidden inside the acceptance transaction\")\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"driver access is forbidden inside a rollback session\")\n        return self._driver\n\n    def close(self) -> None:\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            return  # the acceptance harness owns the shared connection\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"the rollback session owns connection lifetime\")\n        self._driver.close()\n\n    @contextmanager\n    def rollback_session(self):\n        \"\"\"Use this connection for setup, behavior and assertions; always roll back.\n\n        Normal calls remain autocommitted. No schema creation, nested transaction,\n        driver escape, or cross-thread operation is allowed in this scope. Under the acceptance\n        harness the scope is the harness's transaction, rolled back when the criterion ends, so\n        leaving it rolls nothing back.\n        \"\"\"\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            yield self\n            return\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"nested rollback session\")\n        connection = self._driver.connect()\n        cursor = connection.cursor()\n        try:\n            cursor.execute(\"BEGIN\")\n            self._rollback_owner = threading.get_ident()\n            try:\n                yield self\n            finally:\n                try:\n                    cursor.execute(\"ROLLBACK\")\n                except Exception as exc:\n                    raise PersistenceError(f\"acceptance rollback failed: {exc}\") from exc\n                finally:\n                    self._rollback_owner = None\n        finally:\n            cursor.close()\n            self._driver.close()\n\n    def __enter__(self) -> Database:\n        return self\n\n    def __exit__(self, *_: object) -> None:\n        self.close()\n\n    def execute_script(self, sql: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Apply generated DDL. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NqihvJTXydXhqpj1AQH7dQ","type":"tool_result","content":"=== test started at 2026-10-25 14:25:39 ===\nArguments: \nWorking dir: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting\n---\n........................................................................ [ 58%]\n....................................................                     [100%]\n124 passed in 3.19s\n=== test finished at 2026-10-25 14:25:46 with status 0 ===\nexit=0\n\"\"\"``ledger count``: read back through the CLI runner and the store, never from embedded values.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\n\ndef _counts(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef test_count_reports_header_and_stored_rows_in_declared_order(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"UTCNT1\", name=\"Count Probe\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"UTCNTC1\", description=\"Count Category\")\n    scratch_db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=960001, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=\"UTCNT1\", category=\"UTCNTC1\", amount=100, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _counts(out)\n    assert rows[0] == [\"table\", \"rows\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\n    assert [int(row[1]) for row in rows[1:]] == [1, 1, 1]\n\n\ndef test_count_of_empty_store_is_zero_for_every_table(scratch_db):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert [int(row[1]) for row in _counts(out)[1:]] == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_count_tracks_rows_added_after_a_previous_count(scratch_db):\n    def accounts_count() -> int:\n        _, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n        return int(_counts(out)[1][1])\n\n    before = accounts_count()","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"5e5f558a-e99c-4b02-be05-13685f4a202d","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:25:46.684Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"=== test started at 2026-10-25 14:25:39 ===\nArguments: \nWorking dir: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting\n---\n........................................................................ Nothing here writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\n\n\ndef account_summary(db, code: str) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"The stored transaction count and balance in cents of ``code``; ``(0, 0)`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return len(rows), sum(row.amount for row in rows)\n\n\ndef balances(db) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Balance in cents for every account that has at least one stored transaction.\"\"\"\n    totals: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for row in db.transactions.list():\n        totals[row.account] = totals.get(row.account, 0) + row.amount\n    return totals\n\n\ndef check_balances(db, deltas: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject (exit 3) when any account's stored balance plus its proposed change is below zero.\n\n    ``deltas`` maps an account code to the net change in cents the command would make. A balance of\n    exactly zero is allowed. Raises ``Rejected`` before anything is written; returns ``None`` otherwise.\n    \"\"\"\n    current = balances(db)\n    for account in sorted(deltas):\n        after = current.get(account, 0) + deltas[account]\n        if after < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"balance of {account} would be {format_amount(after)}, below zero\")\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db) -> int:\n    \"\"\"One more than the largest stored ``txn_id``, or ``1`` when no transaction is stored.\"\"\"\n    return max((row.txn_id for row in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":25,"oldLines":6,"newStart":25,"newLines":14,"lines":["     return totals"," "," ","+def flows(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:","+    \"\"\"Inflow (sum of positive amounts), outflow (sum of absolute negative amounts), and net, in cents.\"\"\"","+    values = list(amounts)","+    inflow = sum(amount for amount in values if amount > 0)","+    outflow = sum(-amount for amount in values if amount < 0)","+    return inflow, outflow, inflow - outflow","+","+"," def check_balances(db, deltas: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:","     \"\"\"Reject (exit 3) when any account's stored balance plus its proposed change is below zero."," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_016XHyQr68ctbZdF35EqLxYu","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Nothing here writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\n\n\ndef account_summary(db, code: str) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"The stored transaction count and balance in cents of ``code``; ``(0, 0)`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return len(rows), sum(row.amount for row in rows)\n\n\ndef balances(db) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Balance in cents for every account that has at least one stored transaction.\"\"\"\n    totals: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for row in db.transactions.list():\n        totals[row.account] = totals.get(row.account, 0) + row.amount\n    return totals\n\n\ndef flows(amounts: Iterable[int]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Inflow (sum of positive amounts), outflow (sum of absolute negative amounts), and net, in cents.\"\"\"\n    values = list(amounts)\n    inflow = sum(amount for amount in values if amount > 0)\n    outflow = sum(-amount for amount in values if amount < 0)\n    return inflow, outflow, inflow - outflow\n\n\ndef check_balances(db, deltas: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject (exit 3) when any account's stored balance plus its proposed change is below zero.\n\n    ``deltas`` maps an account code to the net change in cents the command would make. A balance of\n    exactly zero is allowed. Raises ``Rejected`` before anything is written; returns ``None`` otherwise.\n    \"\"\"\n    current = balances(db)\n    for account in sorted(deltas):\n        after = current.get(account, 0) + deltas[account]\n        if after < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"balance of {account} would be {format_amount(after)}, below zero\")\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db) -> int:\n    \"\"\"One more than the largest stored ``txn_id``, or ``1`` when no transaction is stored.\"\"\"\n    return max((row.txn_id for row in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," from __future__ import annotations"," ","-from collections.abc import Mapping","+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping"," "," from cli.errors import Rejected"," from cli.money import format_amount"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01L2GuuRGnL2Qgzc9AtxbhAU","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Callers validate everything before calling this.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\n\ndef store_transactions(db, rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[Any]:\n    \"\"\"Create each row in order and return the stored rows.\n\n    The application has no multi-statement transaction, so the group is made all-or-nothing by\n    compensation: when a create fails part-way, the rows already created are deleted before the\n    failure is raised again.\n    \"\"\"\n    created: list[Any] = []\n    try:\n        for row in rows:\n            created.append(db.transactions.create(**row))\n    except PersistenceError:\n        for stored in created:\n            db.transactions.delete(txn_id=stored.txn_id)\n        raise\n    return created\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10449,"cache_read_input_tokens":91328,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":10449},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"d01acbee-9b8e-4ecc-a619-44395096e179","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:26:31.125Z","request_id":"req_011CgPRfcfdiTenb9skrYvED","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01VkL8kDeQKX2qZYozMShtBN":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/writes.py","content":"\"\"\"Store a group of transaction rows as one unit. Callers validate everything before calling this.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\n\ndef store_transactions(db, rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[Any]:\n    \"\"\"Create each row in order and return the stored rows.\n\n    The application has no multi-statement transaction, so the group is made all-or-nothing by\n    compensation: when a create fails part-way, the rows already created are deleted before the\n    failure is raised again.\n    \"\"\"\n    created: list[Any] = []\n    try:\n        for row in rows:\n            created.append(db.transactions.create(**row))\n    except PersistenceError:\n        for stored in created:\n            db.transactions.delete(txn_id=stored.txn_id)\n        raise\n    return created\n"}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRfwvWdymcVJBurmStx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019royoULGe7T4Xg1bJP9Foa","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/account_delete.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account delete <code>``: remove an account that has no transactions.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.balance import account_summary\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"An account with stored transactions is protected; nothing is removed in that case.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"no account {code}\")\n    count, _ = account_summary(db, code)\n    if count:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has {count} transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [[\"deleted\"], [code]]\n\n\nregister((\"account\", \"delete\"), 1, 1, account_delete)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":926,"cache_read_input_tokens":101777,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":926},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"2129ab9a-5472-4abf-a43e-a22ad74d5bcd","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:26:38.269Z","request_id":"req_011CgPRfwaByWDgs1QVPLWN1","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_019royoULGe7T4Xg1bJP9Foa":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/account_delete.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account delete <code>``: remove an account that has no transactions.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.balance import account_summary\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"An account with stored transactions is protected; nothing is removed in that case.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"no account {code}\")\n    count, _ = account_summary(db, code)\n    if count:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has {count} transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [[\"deleted\"], [code]]\n\n\nregister((\"account\", \"delete\"), 1, 1, account_delete)\n"}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRgUUnw1JABvj1awaGF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VBEi9e3LBpMAekcqQobc9u","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/txn_get.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger txn get <id>``: print one stored transaction row.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound\nfrom cli.output import TRANSACTION_HEADER, format_transaction\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_txn_id\n\n\ndef txn_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Header row, then the stored row with its amount as two decimals. Read-only.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = validate_txn_id(args[0])\n    row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n    return [list(TRANSACTION_HEADER), format_transaction(row)]\n\n\nregister((\"txn\", \"get\"), 1, 1, txn_get)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2144,"cache_read_input_tokens":102703,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2144},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"6e4411b9-3c63-4e2a-a45f-c5fc2deff266","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:26:41.648Z","request_id":"req_011CgPRgUASahp3XgLs356GM","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01VBEi9e3LBpMAekcqQobc9u":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/txn_get.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger txn get <id>``: print one stored transaction row.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound\nfrom cli.output import TRANSACTION_HEADER, format_transaction\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_txn_id\n\n\ndef txn_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Header row, then the stored row with its amount as two decimals. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRgUUnw1JABvj1awaGF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CAGNJrqTM6XwCPGS9qXaSS","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/txn_amend.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger txn amend <id> <amount>``: change only the amount of one stored transaction.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.balance import check_balances\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound\nfrom cli.money import parse_amount\nfrom cli.output import TRANSACTION_HEADER, format_transaction\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_txn_id\n\n\ndef txn_amend(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The balance check uses only the change in amount; date, account, category, memo are untouched.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = validate_txn_id(args[0])\n    cents = parse_amount(args[1])\n    row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n    check_balances(db, {row.account: cents - row.amount})\n    updated = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)\n    return [list(TRANSACTION_HEADER), format_transaction(updated)]\n\n\nregister((\"txn\", \"amend\"), 2, 2, txn_amend)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2144,"cache_read_input_tokens":102703,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2144},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"f889d252-600b-4106-ab11-c8e766f0e17d","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:26:44.995Z","request_id":"req_011CgPRgUASahp3XgLs356GM","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01CAGNJrqTM6XwCPGS9qXaSS":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/txn_amend.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger txn amend <id> <amount>``: change only the amount of one stored transaction.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.balance import check_balances\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound\nfrom cli.money import parse_amount\nfrom cli.output import TRANSACTION_HEADER, format_transaction\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_txn_id\n\n\ndef txn_amend(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The balance check uses only the change in amount; date, account, category, memo are untouched.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = validate_txn_id(args[0])\n    cents = parse_amount(args[1])\n    row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n    check_balances(db, {row.account: cents - row.amount})\n    updated = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)\n    return [list(TRANSACTION_HEADER), format_transaction(updated)]\n\n\nregister((\"txn\", \"amend\"), 2, 2, txn_amend)\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UeApn9t6pXmNwyvjGSjh3o","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load_transactions.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"7f537ed1-72ea-43f2-95d5-586606891682","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:26:49.170Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load_transactions.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load transactions <csv>``: all-or-nothing load that keeps each file txn_id.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom cli.balance import check_balances\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\nfrom cli.loader import read_csv_rows\nfrom cli.money import parse_amount\nfrom cli.output import TRANSACTION_HEADER\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.validate import validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo, validate_txn_id\nfrom cli.writes import store_transactions\n\n\ndef load_transactions(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row, reference, and balance first; write only once the whole file has passed.\n\n    Balances are checked on the final balance of each account after the whole file is applied\n    (Decision Q-004), so a row may precede the deposit that funds it.\n    \"\"\"\n    checked: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    seen: set[int] = set()\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for number, fields in enumerate(read_csv_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER), start=1):\n        txn_id_text, date_text, account_text, category_text, amount_text, memo_text = fields\n        row = {\n            \"txn_id\": validate_txn_id(txn_id_text),\n            \"date\": validate_date(date_text),\n            \"account\": validate_code(account_text),\n            \"category\": validate_code(category_text),\n            \"amount\": parse_amount(amount_text),\n            \"memo\": validate_memo(memo_text),\n        }\n        if row[\"txn_id\"] in seen or db.transactions.get(txn_id=row[\"txn_id\"]) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"row {number}: txn_id {row['txn_id']} is repeated or already stored\")\n        if db.accounts.get(account=row[\"account\"]) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"row {number}: no account {row['account']}\")\n        if db.categories.get(category=row[\"category\"]) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"row {number}: no category {row['category']}\")\n        seen.add(row[\"txn_id\"])\n        deltas[row[\"account\"]] = deltas.get(row[\"account\"], 0) + row[\"amount\"]\n        checked.append(row)\n    check_balances(db, deltas)\n    store_transactions(db, checked)\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(checked))]]\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"transactions\"), 1, 1, load_transactions)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01UeApn9t6pXmNwyvjGSjh3o","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRhTPqKKTRg4wxfGXzD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01C3oQoDAfp18UyJahxUDLeD","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/report_balances.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger report balances``: transaction count and balance for every account, with a TOTAL row.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom cli.balance import balances\nfrom cli.money import format_amount\nfrom cli.output import ACCOUNT_HEADER, format_account\nfrom cli.registry import register\n\n\ndef report_balances(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Accounts in code order, then TOTAL with the count and sum over every stored transaction.\"\"\"\n    stored = db.transactions.list()\n    totals = balances(db)\n    counts: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for row in stored:\n        counts[row.account] = counts.get(row.account, 0) + 1\n    rows = [list(ACCOUNT_HEADER)]\n    for account in db.accounts.list():\n        rows.append(\n            format_account(\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRiypxHFBPDepwQ3Bhk","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013pPNzg9Uqxpt963E3qYwqX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_account_commands.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account get|add|rename|delete``: read back through the store after every command.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _post(scratch_db, account: str, cents: int, txn_id: int) -> None:\n    if scratch_db.categories.get(category=\"ACCTC\") is None:\n        scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"ACCTC\", description=\"Account Probe\")\n    scratch_db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2098-01-01\", account=account, category=\"ACCTC\", amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n\n\n# account get\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_name_count_and_balance_of_stored_transactions(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"GET1\", name=\"Get One\")\n    _post(scratch_db, \"GET1\", 10000, 1001)\n    _post(scratch_db, \"GET1\", -2550, 1002)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"GET1\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"], [\"GET1\", \"Get One\", \"2\", \"74.50\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_of_account_without_transactions_reports_zero(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"GET2\", name=\"Empty\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"GET2\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"GET2\", \"Empty\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_shows_negative_balance_with_leading_minus(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"GET3\", name=\"Neg\")\n    _post(scratch_db, \"GET3\", -5, 1003)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"GET3\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][3] == \"-0.05\"\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_account_exits_4_with_no_stdout(scratch_db):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"GETNONE\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"account\", \"get\"], [\"account\", \"get\", \"A\", \"B\"]])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_a_usage_error(scratch_db, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# account add\n\n\ndef test_add_stores_account_and_prints_its_zero_row(scratch_db):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD1\", \"Float\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"], [\"ADD1\", \"Float\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"ADD1\").name == \"Float\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"code_text\", [\"A\", \"A\" * 12, \"Z9\"])\ndef test_add_accepts_codes_at_and_inside_bounds(scratch_db, code_text):\n    code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_text, \"Bounds\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=code_text) is not None\n\n\ndef test_add_accepts_name_at_maximum_length(scratch_db):\n    code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD2\", \"N\" * 40)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"ADD2\").name == \"N\" * 40\n\n\ndef test_add_duplicate_code_exits_3_and_keeps_the_original(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"ADD3\", name=\"Original\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD3\", \"Replacement\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"ADD3\").name == \"Original\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"code_text\", [\"lower\", \"A\" * 13, \"BAD-CODE\", \"\"])\ndef test_add_invalid_code_exits_3_and_stores_nothing(scratch_db, code_text):\n    before = len(scratch_db.accounts.list())\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code_text, \"Valid\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(scratch_db.accounts.list()) == before\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name_text\", [\"\", \"N\" * 41, \"has,comma\"])\ndef test_add_invalid_name_exits_3_and_stores_nothing(scratch_db, name_text):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD4\", name_text)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"ADD4\") is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD5\"], [\"account\", \"add\", \"ADD5\", \"A\", \"extra\"]])\ndef test_add_wrong_argument_count_is_a_usage_error(scratch_db, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"ADD5\") is None\n\n\n# account rename\n\n\ndef test_rename_changes_only_the_name_and_keeps_transactions(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"REN1\", name=\"Before\")\n    _post(scratch_db, \"REN1\", 500, 2001)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"REN1\", \"After\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"REN1\", \"After\", \"1\", \"5.00\"]\n    assert scratch_db.accounts.get(account=\"REN1\").name == \"After\"\n    assert scratch_db.transactions.get(txn_id=2001).account == \"REN1\"\n\n\ndef test_rename_absent_account_exits_4_and_creates_nothing(scratch_db):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"RENNONE\", \"New\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPRju4z29LsGHyULftvn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016iuktjdzsGhpjCktAUgmKY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_txn_commands.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger txn get|post|amend|delete``: each command's effect is read back from the store.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef ledger(scratch_db):\n    \"\"\"One account and one category, both criterion-owned, in the scratch store.\"\"\"\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"TXA\", name=\"Txn Account\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"TXC\", description=\"Txn Category\")\n    return scratch_db\n\n\ndef _store(db, txn_id: int, cents: int, account: str = \"TXA\", memo: str = \"m\") -> None:\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=account, category=\"TXC\", amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n\n\n# txn get\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_header_and_the_stored_row(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 3001, 1234, memo=\"get probe\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"3001\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [HEADER, [\"3001\", \"2026-04-01\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"12.34\", \"get probe\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_formats_negative_amount_with_two_decimals(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 3002, -1250)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"3002\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-12.50\"\n\n\ndef test_get_formats_amount_under_one_unit_with_two_decimals(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 3003, 5)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"3003\")[1])[1][4] == \"0.05\"\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_id_exits_4_with_no_stdout(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"3999\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"txn\", \"get\", \"abc\"], [\"txn\", \"get\", \"1.5\"]])\ndef test_get_non_integer_id_exits_3(ledger, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"txn\", \"get\"], [\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\"]])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_a_usage_error(ledger, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# txn post\n\n\ndef test_post_stores_row_with_next_id_and_prints_it(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 4000, 100)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"45.50\", \"2026-04-02\", \"walk in\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [HEADER, [\"4001\", \"2026-04-02\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"45.50\", \"walk in\"]]\n    stored = ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=4001)\n    assert stored.amount == 4550\n    assert isinstance(stored.amount, int)\n\n\ndef test_post_into_empty_store_assigns_id_one(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][0] == \"1\"\n\n\ndef test_post_without_memo_stores_empty_memo(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 0\n    row = _rows(out)[1]\n    assert len(row) == 6\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=int(row[0])).memo == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"args\",\n    [\n        (\"TXNONE\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXNONE\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"1.234\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"0\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"not-a-date\"),\n        (\"lower\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (\"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"bad,memo\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_post_invalid_input_exits_3_and_stores_nothing(ledger, args):\n    before = len(ledger.transactions.list())\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", *args)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(ledger.transactions.list()) == before\n\n\ndef test_post_payment_beyond_balance_exits_3_and_within_balance_succeeds(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 4100, 1000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"-10.01\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(ledger.transactions.list(account=\"TXA\")) == 1\n    code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert sum(row.amount for row in ledger.transactions.list(account=\"TXA\")) == 500\n\n\ndef test_post_exact_balance_is_allowed(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 4200, 1000)\n    code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"-10.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert sum(row.amount for row in ledger.transactions.list(account=\"TXA\")) == 0\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"], [\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"m\", \"x\"]])\ndef test_post_wrong_argument_count_is_a_usage_error(ledger, argv):\n    before = len(ledger.transactions.list())\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(ledger.transactions.list()) == before\n\n\n# txn amend\n\n\ndef test_amend_changes_only_the_amount(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 5001, 5000, memo=\"keep me\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"5001\", \"60.00\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"5001\", \"2026-04-01\", \"TXA\", \"TXC\", \"60.00\", \"keep me\"]\n    stored = ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=5001)\n    assert stored.amount == 6000\n    assert stored.date == \"2026-04-01\"\n    assert stored.memo == \"keep me\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_absent_id_exits_4(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"5999\", \"1.00\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"amount_text\", [\"0\", \"1.234\", \"abc\"])\ndef test_amend_invalid_amount_exits_3_and_keeps_the_amount(ledger, amount_text):\n    _store(ledger, 5002, 2500)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"5002\", amount_text)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=5002).amount == 2500\n\n\ndef test_amend_that_overdraws_exits_3_and_keeps_the_amount(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 5003, 1000)\n    _store(ledger, 5004, -500)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"5003\", \"0.10\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=5003).amount == 1000\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=5004).amount == -500\n\n\ndef test_amend_within_balance_is_allowed_when_deposit_is_reduced(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 5005, 1000)\n    _store(ledger, 5006, -500)\n    code, _, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"5005\", \"5.00\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert load transactions``: validation of the whole file before the first write.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport os\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef _write(directory, name: str, rows: list[list], header=HEADER) -> str:\n    path = os.path.join(directory, name)\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(list(header))\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return path\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef ledger(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"LTA\", name=\"Load Account\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"LTC\", description=\"Load Category\")\n    return scratch_db\n\n\ndef test_valid_file_keeps_file_txn_ids_and_stores_integer_cents(ledger, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [910001, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"100.00\", \"opening\"],\n        [910002, \"2026-05-02\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"-25.50\", \"spend\"],\n        [910007, \"2026-05-03\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"4.75\", \"gap id kept\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"t.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(out.splitlines())) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", \"3\"]]\n    stored = ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=910007)\n    assert stored.amount == 475\n    assert isinstance(stored.amount, int)\n    assert stored.memo == \"gap id kept\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=910002).amount == -2550\n\n\ndef test_empty_data_section_loads_zero_rows(ledger, tmp_path):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"e.csv\", []))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(out.splitlines()))[1] == [\"transactions\", \"0\"]\n\n\ndef test_unknown_account_in_last_row_stores_none_of_the_valid_rows(ledger, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [920001, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"10.00\", \"ok\"],\n        [920002, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTNONE\", \"LTC\", \"10.00\", \"bad\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"a.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=920001) is None\n\n\ndef test_unknown_category_in_last_row_stores_none_of_the_valid_rows(ledger, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [920011, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"10.00\", \"ok\"],\n        [920012, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTNONE\", \"10.00\", \"bad\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"c.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=920011) is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"bad\",\n    [\n        [920022, \"2026-02-30\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.00\", \"bad date\"],\n        [920023, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.234\", \"three decimals\"],\n        [920024, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"0.00\", \"zero\"],\n        [\"abc\", \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.00\", \"bad id\"],\n        [920025, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.00\", \"N\" * 61],\n        [920026, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.00\", \"has,comma\"],\n    ],\n    ids=[\"impossible-date\", \"third-decimal\", \"zero-amount\", \"non-integer-id\", \"memo-too-long\", \"memo-comma\"],\n)\ndef test_field_rule_violation_rejects_the_whole_file(ledger, tmp_path, bad):\n    anchor = [920021, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"5.00\", \"anchor\"]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"f.csv\", [anchor, bad]))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert ledger.transactions.get(txn_id=anchor[0]) is None\n\n\ndef test_id_repeated_within_the_file_is_refused(ledger, tmp_path):\n    rows = [\n        [930001, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"1.00\", \"one\"],\n        [930001, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA\", \"LTC\", \"2.00\", \"two\"],\n    ]\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", _write(tmp_path, \"d.csv\", rows))\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert test_valid_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids_and_opposite_amounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7001, \"TRS\", 100000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert rows[1] == [\"7002\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRS\", \"TRANSFER\", \"-250.00\", \"transfer to TRD\"]\n    assert rows[2] == [\"7003\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRD\", \"TRANSFER\", \"250.00\", \"transfer from TRS\"]\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7002).amount == -25000\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7003).amount == 25000\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7101, \"TRS\", 50000)\n    _fund(accounts, 7102, \"TRD\", 1000)\n\n    def total(code: str) -> int:\n        return sum(row.amount for row in accounts.transactions.list(account=code))\n\n    before = total(\"TRS\") + total(\"TRD\")\n    assert assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7502) is None\n\n\ndef test_failure_on_second_row_removes_the_first_row(accounts, monkeypatch):\n _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef accounts(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"TRS\", name=\"Source\")\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"TRD\", name=\"Destination\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"TROPEN\", description=\"Opening\")\n    return scratch_db\n\n\ndef _fund(db, txn_id: int, account: str, cents: int) -> None:\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=account, category=\"TROPEN\", amount=cents, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n\n\ndef test_valid_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids_and_opposite_amounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7001, \"TRS\", 100000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert rows[1] == [\"7002\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRS\", \"TRANSFER\", \"-250.00\", \"transfer to TRD\"]\n    assert rows[2] == [\"7003\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRD\", \"TRANSFER\", \"250.00\", \"transfer from TRS\"]\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7002).amount == -25000\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7003).amount == 25000\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7101, \"TRS\", 50000)\n    _fund(accounts, 7102, \"TRD\", 1000)\n\n    def total(code: str) -> int:\n        return sum(row.amount for row in accounts.transactions.list(account=code))\n\n    before = total(\"TRS\") + total(\"TRD\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"100.00\", \"2026-04-03\")[0] == 0\n    assert total(\"TRS\") == 40000\n    assert total(\"TRD\") == 11000\n    assert total(\"TRS\") + total(\"TRD\") == test_valid_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids_and_opposite_amounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7001, \"TRS\", 100000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\",
