together or not at all.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nHEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef accounts(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"TRS\", name=\"Source\")\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"TRD\", name=\"Destination\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"TROPEN\", description=\"Opening\")\n    return scratch_db\n\n\ndef _fund(db, txn_id: int, account: str, cents: int) -> None:\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=account, category=\"TROPEN\", amount=cents, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n\n\ndef test_valid_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids_and_opposite_amounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7001, \"TRS\", 100000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == HEADER\n    assert rows[1] == [\"7002\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRS\", \"TRANSFER\", \"-250.00\", \"transfer to TRD\"]\n    assert rows[2] == [\"7003\", \"2026-04-03\", \"TRD\", \"TRANSFER\", \"250.00\", \"transfer from TRS\"]\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7002).amount == -25000\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7003).amount == 25000\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7101, \"TRS\", 50000)\n    _fund(accounts, 7102, \"TRD\", 1000)\n\n    def total(code: str) -> int:\n        return sum(row.amount for row in accounts.transactions.list(account=code))\n\n    before = total(\"TRS\") + total(\"TRD\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"100.00\", \"2026-04-03\")[0] == 0\n    assert total(\"TRS\") == 40000\n    assert total(\"TRD\") == 11000\n    assert total(\"TRS\") + total(\"TRD\") == before\n\n\ndef test_transfer_of_exact_balance_is_allowed(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7201, \"TRS\", 1000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\")[0] == 0\n    assert sum(row.amount for row in accounts.transactions.list(account=\"TRS\")) == 0\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"args\",\n    [\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRS\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"0\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"0.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRNONE\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRNONE\", \"TRD\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"1.234\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"10.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n    ],\n    ids=[\"same-account\", \"zero\", \"zero-cents\", \"negative\", \"unknown-destination\", \"unknown-source\",\n         \"three-decimals\", \"impossible-date\"],\n)\ndef test_invalid_transfer_exits_3_and_stores_no_rows(accounts, args):\n    _fund(accounts, 7301, \"TRS\", 50000)\n    before = len(accounts.transactions.list())\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(accounts.transactions.list()) == before\n\n\ndef test_transfer_larger_than_source_balance_stores_neither_row(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7401, \"TRS\", 10000)\n    before_all = len(accounts.transactions.list())\n    before_dst = len(accounts.transactions.list(account=\"TRD\"))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"100.01\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(accounts.transactions.list()) == before_all\n    assert len(accounts.transactions.list(account=\"TRD\")) == before_dst\n\n\ndef test_transfer_without_transfer_category_exits_3_and_stores_nothing(accounts):\n    accounts.transactions.delete(txn_id=accounts.transactions.list()[0].txn_id) if accounts.transactions.list() else None\n    _fund(accounts, 7501, \"TRS\", 5000)\n    accounts.categories.delete(category=\"TRANSFER\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7502) is None\n\n\ndef test_failure_on_second_row_removes_the_first_row(accounts, monkeypatch):\n    _fund(accounts, 7601, \"TRS\", 5000)\n    from persistence import PersistenceError\n\n    real_create = accounts.transactions.create\n    calls = {\"n\": 0}\n\n    def flaky_create(**kwargs):\n        calls[\"n\"] += 1\n        if calls[\"n\"] == 2:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"simulated second write failure\")\n        return real_create(**kwargs)\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts.transactions, \"create\", flaky_create)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"TRS\", \"TRD\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7602) is None\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7603) is None\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7601).amount == 5000\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"], [\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-03\", \"x\"]])\ndef test_wrong_argument_count_is_a_usage_error(accounts, argv):\n    before = len(accounts.transactions.list())\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"62a612b1-55df-4ba2-93d6-63d06f16ee75","uuid":"e0168ba1-25af-42c4-a420-6bac1ae88626","timestamp":"2026-10-25T18:28:14.069Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.175746/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_reports.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger report monthly|balances|categories``: every row recomputed from stored rows.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _cents(text: str) -> int:\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text), text\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef ledger(scratch_db):\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"RPA\", name=\"Report A\")\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"RPB\", name=\"Report B\")\n    scratch_db.accounts.create(account=\"RPE\", name=\"Never Used\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"RPC1\", description=\"Used\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"RPC2\", description=\"Unused\")\n    scratch_db.categories.create(category=\"RPC0\", description=\"First by code\")\n    return scratch_db\n\n\ndef _store(db, txn_id: int, date: str, account: str, category: str, cents: int) -> None:\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=account, category=category, amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n\n\n# report monthly\n\n\ndef test_monthly_rows_are_per_month_in_ascending_order_with_total_last(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8001, \"2098-06-10\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 4001)\n    _store(ledger, 8002, \"2098-05-10\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 10000)\n    _store(ledger, 8003, \"2098-05-11\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", -2550)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [\"2098-05\", \"2\", \"100.00\", \"25.50\", \"74.50\"]\n    assert rows[2] == [\"2098-06\", \"1\", \"40.01\", \"0.00\", \"40.01\"]\n    assert rows[3] == [\"TOTAL\", \"3\", \"140.01\", \"25.50\", \"114.51\"]\n\n\ndef test_monthly_total_equals_sum_of_month_rows(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8011, \"2098-07-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 12345)\n    _store(ledger, 8012, \"2098-08-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", -345)\n    rows = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")[1])\n    body, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    assert int(total[1]) == sum(int(r[1]) for r in body)\n    for col in (2, 3, 4):\n        assert _cents(total[col]) == sum(_cents(r[col]) for r in body)\n\n\ndef test_monthly_total_count_equals_stored_transaction_count(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[-1][:2] == [\"TOTAL\", str(len(ledger.transactions.list()))]\n\n\ndef test_monthly_with_no_transactions_has_only_header_and_zero_total(ledger):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"], [\"TOTAL\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\"]]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"report\", \"monthly\", \"extra\"], [\"report\", \"nosuchreport\"], [\"report\"]])\ndef test_monthly_usage_errors_exit_2_with_no_stdout(ledger, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# report balances\n\n\ndef test_balances_list_every_account_by_code_with_count_and_balance(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8101, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 100000)\n    _store(ledger, 8102, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", -30050)\n    _store(ledger, 8103, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPB\", \"RPC1\", 1999)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1:-1] == [\n        [\"RPA\", \"Report A\", \"2\", \"699.50\"],\n        [\"RPB\", \"Report B\", \"1\", \"19.99\"],\n        [\"RPE\", \"Never Used\", \"0\", \"0.00\"],\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_balances_total_row_sums_counts_and_balances(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8111, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 2500)\n    _store(ledger, 8112, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPB\", \"RPC1\", 700)\n    rows = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")[1])\n    total = rows[-1]\n    assert total[:3] == [\"TOTAL\", \"\", \"2\"]\n    assert _cents(total[3]) == 3200\n\n\ndef test_balances_change_by_exactly_the_amount_of_a_later_transaction(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8121, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 8000)\n    before = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")[1])[1]\n    _store(ledger, 8122, \"2098-05-02\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 1234)\n    after = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")[1])[1]\n    assert _cents(after[3]) == _cents(before[3]) + 1234\n    assert int(after[2]) == int(before[2]) + 1\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"report\", \"balances\", \"extra\"], [\"report\"], [\"report\", \"nosuchreport\"]])\ndef test_balances_usage_errors_exit_2_with_no_stdout(ledger, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# report categories\n\n\ndef test_categories_compute_count_inflow_outflow_and_net_and_keep_empty_ones(ledger):\n    amounts = [50000, 1999, -1250, -75]\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        _store(ledger, 8201 + offset, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", cents)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = _rows(out)\n    assert rows[0] == [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [\"RPC0\", \"First by code\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\"]\n    assert rows[2] == [\"RPC1\", \"Used\", \"4\", \"519.99\", \"13.25\", \"506.74\"]\n    assert rows[3] == [\"RPC2\", \"Unused\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_categories_order_by_code_and_total_equals_the_rows(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8301, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 900)\n    _store(ledger, 8302, \"2098-05-02\", \"RPA\", \"RPC0\", -300)\n    rows = _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")[1])\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\" and total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == len(ledger.transactions.list()) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert _cents(total[3]) == sum(_cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert _cents(total[4]) == sum(_cents(r[4]) for r in data)\n    assert _cents(total[5]) == _cents(total[3]) - _cents(total[4])\n\n\ndef test_categories_outflow_rises_and_net_falls_after_a_spend(ledger):\n    _store(ledger, 8401, \"2098-05-01\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", 7000)\n    before = {r[0]: r for r in _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")[1])[1:]}[\"RPC1\"]\n    assert _cents(before[4]) == 0\n    _store(ledger, 8402, \"2098-05-02\", \"RPA\", \"RPC1\", -2345)\n    after = {r[0]: r for r in _rows(cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")[1])[1:]}[\"RPC1\"]\n    assert int(after[2]) == int(before[2]) + 1\n    assert _cents(after[4]) == 2345\n    assert _cents(after[5]) == 7000 - 2345\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"argv\", [[\"report\", \"categories\", \"extra\"], [\"report\"]])\ndef test_categories_usage_errors_exit_2_with_no_stdout(ledger, argv):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*argv)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01PKTYLpeWvjMNruNjP9q2rT","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

amount=cents, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n\n\ndef test_valid_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids_and_opposite_amounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7001, \"TRS\", 100000)\n    code, out, _ = accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7002).amount == -25000\n    assert accounts.transactions.get(txn_id=7003).amount == 25000\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(accounts):\n    _fund(accounts, 7101, \"TRS\", 50000)\n    _fund(accounts, 7102, \"TRD\", 1000)\n\n    def total(code: str) -> int:\n        return sum(row.amount for row in The project suite passes (247 tests, up from 124), and all 59 declared acceptance criteria from the 13 Feature specs pass when run verbatim.\n\nVerification:\n- **Acceptance criteria:** I extracted each `=== AC ===` block and ran it in the shipped acceptance transaction against a fresh schema-only SQLite copy in `/tmp`, so `data/app.db` was not touched. The 123 new tests read state back from the store after each command, and cover the error exit codes and the boundaries.\n- **Guardrails:** no floats in `cli/`, no driver imports outside `persistence/`, and nothing under `sources/` changed.\n\nChoices I made:\n- **Atomic writes:** the shipped persistence layer has no multi-statement transaction for the application. `transfer` and `load transactions` therefore write their rows through `cli/writes.py`, which deletes any rows already created if a later create fails. A failure in that cleanup would itself surface as exit 1.\n- **Transfer and missing `TRANSFER` category:** the spec does not cover this case. I reject it with exit 3 instead of letting a foreign-key error surface as exit 1.\n- **Balance check on load:** the Feature spec (Decision Q-004) checks final balances after the whole file is applied.
